name: Ukraine
who: Russia vs Ukraine, with the US mediating talks
what: Full-scale invasion, now a grinding war of attrition
when: Started Feb 24, 2022 — day 1,650+ and still going
how: Daily drone, missile and artillery strikes along a front over 1,100 km long
current: Russia and Ukraine continue to exchange airstrikes, with a recent Russian strike on a Ukrainian hospital injuring at least 73 people. Ukraine has launched nearly 1,200 drones against Russian positions, while diplomatic talks progress as US envoys met Zelensky in Dublin and Putin agreed to let European negotiators join the next round of peace talks. Grain shipments in the Black Sea remain under threat, and Moscow continues to demand Ukrainian withdrawals and opposes NATO membership.

name: Gaza
what: War technically under ceasefire, but violence continues

current: Despite a ceasefire taking effect on October 11, 2025, Israeli military operations in Gaza continue, with at least 1,643 Palestinians killed and 5,964 injured since that date. The overall death toll since the war began in October 2023 has reached at least 74,695, with nearly the entire population displaced.

name: Sudan
who: Army (SAF) vs the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces
what: Civil war hardening into a formal partition

how: RSF controls Darfur and the west; army holds the center, north and east
current: The conflict between Sudan’s Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces continues, with the United Nations flagging Kordofan as the epicentre. Drone strikes on Khartoum and power stations have killed or wounded hundreds of civilians – 484 since February – and have plunged cities into darkness. More than 14 million people have been displaced since the war began in 2023, including about 4.5 million who have fled to neighbouring countries.

name: Myanmar
who: Military junta vs resistance fighters and ethnic armed groups
what: Civil war following the 2021 coup, now with a civilian facade
when: Coup Feb 1, 2021; Min Aung Hlaing elected president April 3, 2026
how: Junta-backed party swept a sham election; war with resistance forces continues in the borderlands
current: Myanmar’s military has intensified its air campaign, using illicit Iranian jet fuel and urea, and has struck more than a thousand civilian locations over the past fifteen months. The civil war, which began after the February 2021 coup, has killed over 100,000 people, displaced 5.2 million, and is now in a stalemate, with resistance forces controlling about 42 % of the country while the junta holds roughly 21 %. Recent airstrikes have caused heavy civilian casualties, including an attack that killed at least 50 civilians. Meanwhile, about 1,500 migrants have arrived in Myanmar from Malaysia despite UN warnings about the ongoing conflict.

current: Violence in eastern DR Congo remains severe as M23 rebels, who seized Goma and Bukavu in early 2025, continue to control key towns and have displaced hundreds of thousands of people. Impact on the United States is assessed as low.

name: Taiwan Strait
who: China (PLA) vs Taiwan, with the US and Japan backing Taipei
what: Escalating military pressure just short of open conflict
how: Record Chinese aircraft and ship incursions into Taiwan’s air defense zone
current: China flew a record 2,076 sorties into Taiwan’s air defense identification zone through the year, Taiwan’s defense minister said — a pace so intense it complicates distinguishing routine drills from preparation for war. Taiwan has deployed HIMARS and put M1A2T Abrams tanks through combat-readiness drills, and President Lai has reiterated Taiwan’s "self-defense resolve," accusing Beijing of altering the regional status quo. Beijing has reportedly set 2027 as a rough internal benchmark for a credible invasion capability, though analysts are divided on whether that timeline is realistic, and there’s no current evidence an invasion is imminent.
